desc: Instaparse is a parsing library for Clojure that builds parsers from arbitrary context-free grammars. This talk will explain the underlying algorithm and discuss how Clojure shaped the design and implementation of the library.

recs.stt: Why monads have not taken the Common Lisp world by storm (2008)
